method: The verification builds the workspace adapter, then the observer registers an in-process public LLM adapter and routes ctx.agents through HarnessAgentRuntime. HarnessAgentRuntime creates the official Agent, sends an identified user message, waits for agent.whenIdle(), decodes the assistant event with host-side usage, and disposes the returned handle.
notProven: Production Bundle/coordinator composition that wires the adapter and decoder into the orchestration port
A real DeepSeek credential/model network request
Codex Chrome browser E2E against the Web UI
releaseImpact: Production Agent binding, browser E2E, and release remain blocked until the missing mappings and gates are verified.
